intent.description: Intent states product need and outcome without choosing an unforced implementation.
intent.example_prompt: Judge solution-agnostic only. Confirm problem, outcome, acceptance, and non-goals describe a product need rather than an unforced internal mechanism. Template: crates/software-change-provider/data/templates/intent.md. Schema: crates/software-change-provider/data/configs/standard.json#/artifact_schemas/intent.json. Deny only a material defect plausibly affecting change success against intent; minor blemishes, style, length/count proxies, silence, and invented norms are not findings. Do not waive material finding. Materiality guard: silence is not a finding; check omissions only against the named acceptance/requirements set — do not hunt for unlisted omissions; do not invent norms; length/count proxies are not findings.

design-review.description: the axis judges that every design mechanism is forced by a named requirement and no needed mechanism is missing.
design-review.example_prompt: Judge mechanism-forced only. Symmetric test: every mechanism, section, or configurable surface in the design must name (or obviously trace to) a forcing requirement — an unforced mechanism is a material defect (overbuild); conversely a claimed simplification or omission is a finding only if a concrete uncovered failure or unmet requirement can be named (no simplicity-for-its-own-sake denials).
